stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 remote <command> [--] [<args>...]

Manage remotes.

Subcommands:
    add <name> <url>              Add a new remote
    remove <name>                 Remove a remote
    rename <old> <new>            Rename a remote
    set-url [--push] <name> <url> Set remote URL
    show [-v|--verbose]           Show remotes

Options:
    <command>
        the subcommand (add, remove, rename, set-url, show)
    <args>...
        arguments for the subcommand
